BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE (INFORMATION SYSTEMS)


Programme Overview

This programme aims to equip graduates with the ability to apply the concepts and principles of Information Systems to support the design, development and management of Information Systems. The graduates will be able to design and develop Information Systems to suit the organizational needs using highest quality technology-based services, with high ethical values in the context of professional practice of computing.


Duration:  3.5 Years (7 Semester and 1 special semester), Full time (Coursework)

Entry Requirement

SPM / O-Level / Equivalent Subject Requirements:

Obtain at least Grade B in THREE (3) of the following subjects: 
  • Mathematics
  • Additional Mathematics
  • Any ONE (1) subjects: Physics / Chemistry / Biology / Computer Science / Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
STPM
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.00 in Science stream and;
  • Obtain a minimum of grade B- in Additional Mathematics and Grade B- in any of the following subjects:
    • Physics
    • Information and Communication Technology
    • Chemistry
    • Biology
Matriculation / Foundation
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.00 in Science Stream and;
  • Obtain a minimum of grade B- in Mathematics at Matriculation/Foundation and Grade B- in any of the following subjects:
    • Physics
    • Fundamentals of Information and Communication Technology
    • Chemistry
    • Biology
    • Computer Science
    • IT
    • Programming
    • Computing 
STAM
  • Not Offered
Diploma / Equivalent
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Obtain a minimum CGPA of 3.00 from a recognised institution approved by UM Senate; and
  • Obtain a minimum of grade B- in any 2 subjects at Diploma level including Mathematics
UM SATU Foundation
